history.name: Any project, in any language
history.description: The record is a directory of plain data files in the project's own repository, and every operation is a command run against it — so a Python service, a Go binary, a Rails app and a JavaScript front end all look identical to the tool. Nothing has to be installed into the project being documented, and nothing about the record assumes what the product is written in.
history.dev_notes: Requires Node 18.17+ on the machine, but not in the host project; installable globally, as a dev dependency, from a tarball, or run straight from a checkout by path.
